protocol.controller: Shared per-tensor MLP produces a bounded log learning-rate multiplier for an Adam-shaped update. Inputs are differentiable gradient/weight RMS, gradient-momentum cosine, moment RMS, step feature and current loss. Zero output initialization reproduces the declared fixed Adam rule. Controller weights persist across student tasks.
protocol.self_application: After bootstrap meta-learning, the learned updater processes gradients of its own parameters and proposes a changed controller. A fixed evaluator accepts only if four fresh validation tasks improve and four retained validation tasks stay within tolerance. Compare the accepted controller with the frozen bootstrap copy and fixed-rate baselines on untouched final tasks.
evidence_rules: Numerically check a meta-gradient on deterministic dummy data before scored runs
Record every self-update proposal, rejection, evaluation and cost
No final-task data in meta-training, self-update or admission
Charge bootstrap, baseline-rate selection, self trials and evaluation separately
Do not call bootstrap meta-learning recursive self-improvement
Zero accepted beneficial self-updates is a failed self-application result
protocol.scope: Necessary learned-procedure experiment, not the full architecture. Students reset between meta tasks; persistent task-knowledge retention is not proved here. The controller family and admission evaluator remain fixed. Even successful bounded self-application would not establish open-ended recursive improvement, general reasoning, architecture invention or long-horizon agent efficiency.

prior_art.relationship: Conceptual reference for learned update policies and unrolled meta-gradients. This small PyTorch implementation is independently written and is not a reproduction or novelty claim.
